title: Production viability vetting
description: Document and test production-readiness risks for the local control plane: auth and tenancy enforcement, schema migration discipline, attachment/storage behavior, realtime/subscription strategy, observability, backup/restore, and performance under high-volume models.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Production vetting slice starting. Current local MVP evidence: CLI smoke, prediction writeback, feedback evaluation, report artifact persistence through MinIO, browser smoke coverage, and Qdrant-backed VectorTopicMemory all pass locally with no hosted GraphQL upstream requests. This slice will add executable evidence plus a concise risk register for production blockers rather than implementing full production hardening.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Production viability vetting evidence implemented. Added executable harness scripts/vet-local-control-plane.sh, focused proxy tests, and documentation/local-control-plane-production-vetting.md. Verification passed: targeted proxy tests, full clean local proof harness, and production vetting harness. Vetting result: pass=1, risk=5, blocked=0. Key surfaced risks are auth/tenancy isolation, schema migration readiness, realtime implementation, high-volume query shape, and operations/backup readiness; MinIO/Qdrant/no-upstream boundary evidence passes.
